quarterly_data.quarter: QuEra Computing press release: QuEra Scientists Named Co-Principal Investigators on Three (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: QuEra scientists are co-principal investigators on three of the nine teams selected for ARPA-E's Quantum Computing for Computational Chemistry (QC3) program (a three-year Department of Energy program directing $37 million across all performers) - SuperKIQ (led by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory), MAGNETIQC (Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory) and a hydrogen fuel production project (Phasecraft) - contributing neutral-atom access and algorithm and architecture co-design; QuEra is the external hardware provider partner for three of the four projects whose primes are not hardware companies. The release states QuEra's updated roadmap targets 1,000 logical qubits by 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: roadmap target 1,000 logical qubits by 2029; QC3 program $37 million across all performers
